description: The price list. Read-only and free: nothing is created or charged. Returns every plan on sale (name, USD per month, credits per month, USD per credit), every one-time credit pack (credits, USD, USD per credit) and, when this account would get it at checkout, the first-purchase offer. Also returns what things cost in credits: a video, and each add-on or clip product that is switched on, with its credits per unit (per scene, or per second with the length range). account.usdPerCredit is what one credit costs this account in USD (usdPerCreditBasis says where the number comes from), so a credit price can be told to the user in dollars. All prices are what customers pay; tax may be added at checkout. Requires the "video:read" scope.
name: list_pricing
title: List prices
